recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Dr. Barre Lando of Alfa Vedic has spent decades reading the human energy field with instruments most people have never heard of, from Lecher antennas to biogeometry pendulums to a dowsing rod calibrated to the 18 dimensions of a waveform. The thread running through all of it is that the ether is not a canvas you paint on but a living intelligence that paints back, and you are the instrument.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: This episode covers radiesthesia and radionics as a two-way science, dowsing rods and Lecher antennas as radio dials for finer bands of the ether, Walter Russell's 18 qualitative dimensions of a waveform, biogeometry and Ibrahim Karim's pyramid-chamber research, and the alchemical mercury, salt, and sulfur as soul, body, and prana. Also covers the four levels of ether, tuning forks and the five elements as musical notes in Chinese meridian therapy, reading distortion in the toroidal field, and the Alfa Vedic farm as a working prototype for decentralization.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Ascended Masters and the Seven Rays", "body": "Lando is careful to say he does not run around with those sorts of characters, but he has spent decades alongside people from the original Saint Germain Foundation, including some who worked with the originals and who demonstrated they were not channeling anything but receiving direct transmission. He reads the constellations as seven rays, each carrying an original attribute that resonates into form. Saint Germain holds the violet ray, the freeing ray that purifies the earthly distortions we pick up and then view reality through. The second ray is gold and pure love, the green ray governs science."}, {"title": "Controlled Opposition in Religion and the New Age", "body": "Every spiritual movement gets infiltrated, Lando argues, and the Saint Germain Foundation was attacked by government from outside and distorted from within by figures he names, including Elizabeth Clare Prophet. Religion itself, he says, is controlled opposition once again, however high its stated ideals. Chance builds the same case historically, tracing dogma to a public that got hold of only the entry level of the mysteries, mistook allegory for literal history, and froze it. He sees the identical slope in the New Age, where patron gods are collected as literal entities and ascension cults promise a pathway while feeding on the people who follow it."}, {"title": "The Tenth Hierarchy and the Freedom Test", "body": "According to the teachings Lando works from, humanity sits inside a tenth hierarchy whose entire lesson is freedom, which is why a predator class is working so hard to make us agree that authority exists and must be obeyed. He frames this as the closing of a long historical loop, the last attribute to be earned before a golden age, and the choice available in every incarnation is stark. Give free will away under the name of an external authority, or claim total freedom once and for all. He hedges that these are his beliefs, held because they have proved out in his own experience."}, {"title": "Placenta, Blood, and Lack Magic", "body": "Chance lays out a hypothesis he has been circling for years, that the placenta is a genetic twin and a kind of guardian, cut away at birth and disposed of without ceremony, and he calls the practice lack magic rather than black magic since there is no disease, only a lack. Lando answers with laboratory evidence. He reads a mailed drop of blood by radiesthesia and then burns it, and in his microscope years he watched blood already outside the body change on screen as he treated the person on the table. Samples, he notes, get sent to a clearing house and kept."}, {"title": "Minerals as the Oldest Technology", "body": "Asked about crystals as a life form, Lando answers from the alchemist lab, where minerals outrank plant and animal preparations because a stone has gathered and concentrated resonance for tens of thousands of years without the impediment of an animated human consciousness. That potency cuts both ways, and he warns that mineral remedies can take you somewhere you are not ready to go. Minerals are also the basis of information storage, which makes them transmitter receivers far beyond a silica chip, and he recalls a mentor who would close his hands over a stone in Lando's palm and put him somewhere else entirely."}]
